episodes.title: The Catevari
episodes.description: Darien must capture a Catevari, a man-made monster who can kill with a mere scratch of his fingernails.

episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.description: A small-time thief (Vincent Ventresca) must work for an underfunded governmental agency or get solitary confinement.

episodes.title: Ralph
episodes.description: Darien plays the imaginary friend of a girl being stalked by a deadly sniper.

episodes.title: Tiresias
episodes.description: Darien and his partner, Bobby Hobbes, investigate the suicide of a police officer.

episodes.title: Impetus
episodes.description: Darien sets off a disastrous chain of events when he spies on the Keeper.

episodes.title: The Devil You Know
episodes.description: Darien is called in to help the Agency save a kidnapped businessman and thus raise their profile, but the man is accidently killed.

episodes.title: Liberty and Larceny
episodes.description: Darien must choose between the past and the future when he runs into his old partner in crime.

episodes.title: The Value of Secrets
episodes.description: While investigating a security breach, Darien discovers an opportunity to escape and must decide between helping himself and solving the case.

episodes.title: Separation Anxiety
episodes.description: Hobbes is worried that his ex-wife is going to marry a criminal, and his suspicions are borne out when Darien discovers that the man is planning to sell government weapons to a gangster.

episodes.title: Separation Anxiety
episodes.description: A suspicious stranger turns out to be an undercover agent working to stop the sale of illegal weapons.

episodes.title: It Hurts When You Do This
episodes.description: Darien discovers a dangerous side to medical experiments after a friend is suddenly cured of short-term memory loss.

episodes.title: Reunion
episodes.description: Darien rides a roller coaster of high hopes and harsh realities after his brother Kevin, whom he thought was dead, mysteriously reappears.

episodes.title: Cat & Mouse
episodes.description: The Chinese government tries to steal the model, Darien Fawkes, after its attempts to create an invisible man fail.

episodes.title: Beholder
episodes.description: The rest of the world becomes invisible to Darien after he's blinded while on the trail of an international assassin.

episodes.title: Ghost of a Chance
episodes.description: Darien learns of the Dark Woman, another invisible entity, when he travels to South America to stop a nation's leader from deploying chemical weapons.

episodes.title: Flowers For Hobbes
episodes.description: Hobbes is accidentally injected with a retrovirus that raises his intelligence to genius level, but also has a sinister side effect.

episodes.title: Flowers for Hobbes
episodes.description: Darien finds a link to the past and Hobbes discovers a promising future when on the trail of the thief who stole samples from the Nobel Sperm bank.

episodes.title: Frozen in Time
episodes.description: Darien finds himself on a collision course with his past when the Dark Woman kidnaps an old friend and plans to cryogenically freeze her.

episodes.title: Diseased
episodes.description: Arnaud De Fehrn, Darien's old foe, orchestrates a flu outbreak that causes a deadly and mysterious infection in Darien's quicksilver gland.

episodes.title: The Lesser Evil
episodes.description: Darien reacts with cynicism toward an invitation from Allianora to attend a meeting with "The Organization" and begins to question his own agency's intentions.

episodes.title: Money for Nothing
episodes.description: The Agency develops a get-rich-quick scheme to fatten its paltry budget by using Darien's invisibility, but the temptation to escape with the stolen money gets the better of him.

episodes.title: It's a Small World
episodes.description: The Chrysalis organization implants a computer virus-like bug into Darien's bloodstream that enables them to follow his every move.

episodes.title: Money for Nothing
episodes.description: After temptation causes Darien to risk it all for a chance at freedom, he inches dangerously close to "quicksilver madness" and asks Hobbes to join him in his plan.

title: The Invisible Man
description: A former thief has the ability to become invisible.

100.text: A former thief has the ability to become invisible.
